openings.probe: Construct both variants from the same inspected evidence across the disjoint three-pair subsets. Freeze initial reports, citations, next checks and counts. During final review perform the supplied random removals in two pairs, withdraw removed-record evidence and recompute using retained inspected records. Freeze revised outputs before opening the two sealed answer sheets. assumptions: Manifest order is expected order; timestamp anomalies remain observations. Every definite stage cites an available supplied record; mismatch and explanation remain separate.
False signals: manifest misalignment can mimic withdrawal. Cancelling signals: redundant retained support can make removal irrelevant. Blank warnings prove neither execution nor success.

Defeat: unverified alias identity, incomparable boundaries, missing earlier coverage, or identical justified responses. Fallback intervals require no alias resource; no performance advantage is presumed.
